name: Tevrna Business Manager Suite
author: tevrna

sections.description:
Tevrna Business Manager Suite is a powerful, lightweight micro-ERP designed specifically for small businesses, agencies, and online stores. It transforms your standard WordPress backend into a complete command center to manage your daily operations, track your team’s productivity, and monitor your business growth.

Whether you are managing a physical supply chain, tracking marketing spend, or assigning tasks to your team, everything is organized into clean, lightning-fast tabs.

Core Free Features

  • Sales & Supply Chain: Quickly add new manual orders, track quantities sold, and calculate your net profit (automatically, from each product’s unit cost).
  • WooCommerce Auto-Sync: Automatically captures and logs incoming WooCommerce orders and customer details directly into your ERP, and updates your stock (matched by SKU or product name).
  • CRM (Customer Profiles): Save detailed customer information, track their lifetime order history, and leave manual manager notes.
  • Inventory Management: Add unlimited products/SKUs with a unit cost, track live stock levels, and update stock automatically: stock is deducted when a sale is recorded and returned when an order is cancelled, returned, edited or deleted.
  • Team & Task Management: Build a roster of your employees, assign them to specific departments, track their annual leave (PTO), and assign them daily tasks with due dates.
  • Marketing Campaigns: Plan your ad spend, log your campaign targets across platforms like Facebook and Instagram, and log social interactions.
  • Content & Idea Planner: A built-in scratchpad and content calendar to schedule your future social media posts and project ideas.
  • WhatsApp Message Preview: After every new order or status change, see the ready-to-send WhatsApp message for that customer.

Unlock the Pro Version

Ready to scale your business? The Pro version of Tevrna Business Manager Suite unlocks the heavy-duty analytics and administrative tools you need to take total control:

  • Advanced Visual Analytics: Unlock 6 dynamic, date-filtered Chart.js graphs tracking your Sales & Profit timeline, Orders Per Month, Order Fulfillment, and Customer Demographics.
  • Global CSV Data Exports: Download perfectly formatted spreadsheets of your sales, finances, customers, and inventory logs in one click.
  • Asset Vault & Media Uploads: A private digital locker for company documents (files are stored in a protected folder and only open for users with Vault access). Plus, attach photos and videos directly to your Content Planner, Ideas, and Team Tasks!
  • One-Click WhatsApp Messages: Open the message in WhatsApp with one click, edit and save your own message template with dynamic tags ({name}, {order}, {status}), and set a default country code for local phone numbers.
  • Unified Finance Ledger: Manually record custom internal expenses (OUT) and business investments (IN) to track your true net profit and monitor individual partner balances.
  • Permanent Team Note History: Keep a permanent, timestamped history of manager notes and performance reviews for every employee.
  • Granular Access Control: Not everyone needs to see your finances. Secure your ERP by choosing exactly which tabs each employee account is allowed to view.
  • Deep Inventory History: View timestamped, itemized logs of every time stock was added, deducted, or manually adjusted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/tevrna-business-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Click on the new “Business Hub” menu item in your left-hand WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Start adding your team members, logging your inventory, and tracking your sales!
sections.faq:
Does this integrate with WooCommerce?

Yes! The free version automatically detects when WooCommerce is active. When a new order is placed in your WooCommerce store, the ERP automatically pulls the customer’s data into the CRM and logs the sale in your Sales tab.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely. All ERP data is stored entirely on your own WordPress database. We do not transmit your private customer or financial data to any external servers.

How do I upgrade to the Pro version?

You can upgrade at any time by clicking the “Upgrade to Pro” buttons on any locked feature inside the plugin, or by visiting the Pricing tab in your WordPress dashboard.
sections.changelog:
6.6

  • New: Unit Cost for inventory products. Net profit is calculated automatically for manual and WooCommerce orders.
  • New: Stock is returned automatically when an order is cancelled, returned, refunded, edited or deleted.
  • New: Start Date for marketing campaigns. Ad spend now appears in Finance on the campaign’s start date.
  • New: Customer custom fields are now shown in the customer profile.
  • Fix: WooCommerce customers were marked “Returning” on their very first order.
  • Fix: WooCommerce orders now update inventory stock and use the real order date.
  • Fix: Refunded WooCommerce orders are no longer counted as received money.
  • Fix: Two identical finance entries are no longer merged into one in the ledger.
  • Fix: Leave days stop accruing after an employee is marked as terminated.
  • Fix: Empty idea deadlines no longer show as 0000-00-00.
  • Fix: Database update errors when the plugin was re-activated.
  • Fix: PHP 8.1+ deprecation notices.
  • Fix: Better compatibility with SQLite-based hosts and WordPress Playground.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

6.5

  • Initial stable release on the WordPress Plugin Directory.
